name.description: Cartridge identifier. Used as the prefix in <|call|>name.method <|/call|>.

args_schema.description: Path to JSON Schema for the method args. The kernel compiles the opcode list from it: enum-valued properties, and integers carrying both minimum and maximum (with optional multipleOf). Capped at 512 opcodes per method. See PLAN.md.

items.description: Complete opcode string the LLM may emit. Must match the form '<|call|>NAME.METHOD <args>\n<|/call|>\n' for the trie to route correctly.

opcodes.description: Explicit opcode strings. Optional override for methods the schema compiler cannot express yet; normally omitted.

halt.description: Optional override for halt opcodes. Defaults to [success/failure/partial] if omitted.
